modules.name: sb_stream_elastic
limitations: one elastic entry; combinational backward READY
native shared-clk_en transfer contract; not unrestricted AXI Stream

modules.name: sb_stream_register_slice
limitations: STAGES>=1; uses sb_stream_elastic
READY path remains combinational through stages

modules.name: sb_stream_width_adapter
limitations: byte widths with integer ratio only
lane-preserving conversion; no KEEP compaction
narrowing emits all chunks including zero-KEEP beats
widening retains first USER and pulses error if subsequent USER differs

modules.name: sb_stream_rr_arbiter
limitations: packet lock until accepted LAST; no timeout/preemption for missing LAST
one output elastic register; uses sb_stream_elastic
bounded fairness requires finite frames and cooperative downstream

modules.name: sb_axil_register_bank
limitations: 32/64-bit data, aligned RW registers, one outstanding read and write
AWPROT/ARPROT accepted without access-control filtering
same-cycle read/write returns previous register value
clk_en gates request acceptance; response channels continue standard AXI handshakes

modules.name: sb_axil_crossbar_placeholder
limitations: legacy name; one AXI-Lite initiator, uniform power-of-two slave windows
one outstanding read and write; independent AW/W; stripped local addresses
unmapped regions DECERR; downstream response codes preserved
no timeout or multi-initiator arbitration; address width at most 32

modules.name: sb_axi4_native_bridge
limitations: aligned full-width FIXED up to 16 beats and INCR up to 256 beats
WRAP/reserved, narrow, misaligned, 4KiB-crossing and address-overflow requests explicitly SLVERR without native accesses
one outstanding read and write sharing one serialized request/response native port; IDs retained
byte strobes; WLAST mismatch pulses protocol_error and yields SLVERR after AWLEN+1 beats; previous writes are not rolled back
native responses must be held until accepted; no timeout, burst reordering, locks, cache/protection/QOS sidebands

modules.name: sb_axi4_burst_bridge_placeholder
limitations: legacy name; wraps native bridge in parameterized MEM_WORDS synchronous byte-write RAM
RAM contents unspecified at startup and retained across reset; transactions aborted by reset
out-of-range native addresses SLVERR; earlier legal beats may already have committed
standalone endpoint, no external native memory port; use sb_axi4_native_bridge for external memory
